ui.tz_milestone_guide: Ago & iyipada (UTC{tz_str}): Yiyan ago n ṣatunṣe akoko; yiyipada UTC le gbe oniṣowo lọ si ọjọ iṣaaju tabi ti o tẹle.
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Ẹrọ Akoko: Fa awọn ọjọ sẹhin tabi siwaju lati ṣayẹwo data ti o kọja tabi iwaju. Wiwo nikan ni.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN ipilẹ: o fẹ data gidi, o ṣayẹwo ṣiṣan ipele & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + jitter kọja k, p; lori awọn aafo 16 / 116 / 132 tabi iy൪kiri 1072 o nlo k*116 + p*16 kọja k, p lati ba ipele mu, kikun awọn aafo si iwaju ti wọn ba sonu.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Aiyipada si 119 rhythm (k*119 + jitter); nigbati aafo ba jẹ 16 / 116 / 132 tabi de iyika 1072 (apẹrẹ igbesẹ 14), o nlo k*116 + p*16 kọja k, p lati yipada si Ipele A ti o baamu (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: O n yi pẹlu 119 rhythm (k*119 + jitter); lori awọn aafo 16 / 116 / 132 tabi iyika 1072 (k*116 + p*16 kọja k, p), o nifẹ ipele ti a tunṣe A2 / C7 o si n pada sẹhin nigbati data ba sonu.
